theorems.name: closure_iff_zSq
theorems.statement: THE TIGHTNESS STATEMENT: the closure carries NO slack -- the identity 32*pi*a0^2/(3 H0^2 c^2) = Omega holds (given the horizon pair) IFF Z^2 = 32*pi/3; the germ identity is EXACTLY equivalent to the cosmological self-consistency
